title: Superset console is reachable without authentication
description: The Apache Superset console is served without authentication. Superset holds database connections and lets its users run SQL Lab queries through them.
remediation: Require the Superset login or SSO, and keep Superset off the public host.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Superset console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Superset</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
